findings.body: This test changes the item's configuration but invokes every merge command from the main checkout: tests/conftest.py:69 defaults cwd to env.repo.path. Replacing default_config() with config(root()) would therefore still pass. Likewise, removing the fetch would pass because these pushes already update the local origin/main reference. Run the command from the item's worktree with conflicting configuration, and change the remote default branch from a separate clone so the test requires fetching to observe it. These are required protections in Done-when 2.
findings.title: Not done: default-branch configuration isolation and freshness test

findings.body: The only new close/next test enables agent merging. There is no end-to-end assertion that closing an item with the default human setting creates the ready record and then makes forge next request a human merge, as Done-when 3 requires. tests/test_close.py:512 checks the existing human close message, but does not cover the new receipt-driven next step. A regression that always recommends forge merge for recorded-ready items would pass this coverage. Add the human-setting flow through the real commands and assert the receipt and human next step.
findings.title: Not done: human-merge ready flow test
